changing_places.note: On the lower floor; RADAR key from the John Islip Street reception

There is a ramp down to the Manton entrance with central handrails.

lift.note: From the lower floor to the main floor, and to the upper floor

sources.quote: A large lift near the Manton Entrance gives access up to the gallery areas on the main floor.
